name: gopeed-extension-gdrive
author: your-username
title: Google Drive Resolver
description: Resolves Google Drive file and folder links and lists all downloadable contents.

settings.name: apiKey
settings.title: Google Drive API Key (Required for Folders)
settings.description: Create a free API Key in Google Cloud Console with Google Drive API v3 enabled to list full folder contents and bypass virus scan prompts.

settings.name: recursive
settings.title: Resolve Subfolders Recursively
settings.description: Automatically traverse nested subfolders when resolving a Drive folder.
